component.name: Acrimonious Reader
component.summary: Read PDFs, fill in forms and sign them

description.p: A fast PDF viewer for GNOME. Pages render on a background thread, so scrolling and zooming stay smooth even in large, heavy documents.

ul.li: Zoom to fit, pinch and Ctrl+scroll zoom, dual pages, rotation and night mode
Thumbnails, the document outline, and search across the whole document
Text boxes and freehand drawing, saved as standard PDF annotations, for filling in and signing forms
Saved signatures: draw yours once, then place it on any document with a click
Links with back and forward, text selection and copying, printing
Reloads automatically when the file changes, and remembers where you were in every document

screenshot.caption: A document with the page sidebar and a search

description.p: Installing or uninstalling from source no longer touches saved signatures. Packages are now also available from an apt repository.
Saved signatures: draw your signature once and place it on any document with a click. Annotations can now be resized with a handle.
